# Lorna Vane & Rufus Vane

- [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) — Spouse of — [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) — since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), +7 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks through a foggy night to visit [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), but retreats upon seeing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) weeping bitterly inside her home. Outside, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) encounters Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) and [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), and Captain Saul walks her back home while discussing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and the nature of the foggy darkness.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P19](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0019)_

> During a cold winter at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019)_

> [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) drops off [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) at Nell's house before rushing off to help a neighbor. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduces Adrian to the area, walks him over to his new lodging at the Vane house, and watches as he is struck by [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's striking beauty.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)_

> [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) agrees to write Captain Saul's life story incorporating the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he spends a glorious summer working on the manuscript at the lighthouse. Along with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), and [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), Adrian enjoys coastal outings while finishing the novel, which he concludes by September.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_

> Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035)_

> [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) secures funds from Captain Saul and travels to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Hugh and Rufus for the surgery. After returning home, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receive a letter from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) with a shocking revelation: the man they believed to be Rufus for twelve years is actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), while the real Rufus died in Cuba long ago.
>
